views.name: Overview
views.summary: Combines recorded flight data with aircraft details and any available flight-controller configuration, organized by topic. Review basics such as propeller size, blade count, and motor layout alongside setup checks, warnings, and flight facts before going deeper.
views.availability: Available for opened Betaflight logs. Individual cards appear only when their source data exists.

views.name: Table
views.summary: Shows selected recorded or derived fields as timestamped rows, with decoded events inserted into the same ordered view.
views.availability: Requires a readable main-frame time range and at least one selected field.

views.name: Graph
views.summary: Plots selectable signals on a shared time axis with events, range measurement, playback, and a synchronized craft inspector.
views.availability: Requires readable time-series fields; unavailable configured fields remain visible but cannot produce a trace.

views.name: Spectrum
views.summary: Examines selected signals by frequency, frequency versus throttle, or frequency versus motor RPM. It can overlay recorded filter settings, tracked Dynamic and RPM notch centres, firmware-matched calculated attenuation, measured motor bands, and individually selectable blade-pass orders.
views.availability: Frequency analysis needs suitable sampled fields. Throttle and RPM modes need their respective data; RPM mode additionally needs eRPM fields. Each mode shows its applicable Guides in the sidebar. Profile ranges require a supported propeller size; blade-pass guides require an Airframe document, enabled Guides, and a numeric blade count found by Airframe or selected in Aircraft Settings.

views.name: System Response
views.summary: Estimates ordinary-flight step response from setpoint and gyro data, and exposes chirp frequency response, spectrograms, and a bounded tune score when a complete modern CHIRP payload is present.
views.availability: Step Response needs sufficient setpoint and filtered-gyro excitation. Frequency Response needs complete supported CHIRP intervals and debug channels.

views.name: Map
views.summary: Replays a usable GPS route with the shared cursor, optional heading, home, and event markers, plus an altitude, speed, or distance timeline.
views.availability: Requires at least two distinct retained GPS positions. Optional overlays require the matching recorded data.
